data.long_meaning: In Aramaic, Bartholomew means 'son of Tolmai.' In the Bible, he is one of the 12 apostles, also known as Nathanael. He was known for his quick faith and was called a 'man without deceit.'. The name Bartholomew carries the meaning “Son of Tolmai” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bartholomew usually hope their child will grow to embody son of tolmai and live with faith, good character and purpose.
